Questions

Before you book

Do I need to be home?

No, if the yard is safely accessible and entry instructions are confirmed.

Can my dog stay in the yard?

That depends on the dog's behavior and the service policy. We confirm a safe plan before the first visit.

What happens to the collected waste?

Disposal arrangements are confirmed when you book because local service options can differ.

Can I book only one cleanup?

Yes. One-time cleanup is available for seasonal buildup, events or catching up.
